## Goal
Create the in-memory Observation, Diagnosis, and NextAction class model with JSON conversion, markdown rendering, severity policy, and legacy adapter support.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Classes enforce invariants in constructors.
- Observation.signature() returns the fields needed by existing Jaccard comparison.
- Legacy adapter fills unavailable fields with null, empty string, or empty array and has no phase-specific branches.

## Implementation Notes
Implement in `src/flow/lib/observation.js`. Keep wire JSON plain and in-memory processing class-based.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for constructor validation, toJSON/fromJSON, toMarkdown, signature, severity policy, and adapter conversion.
